chat:
SELECT 1 AS permitted
FROM n_media_assets a
WHERE a.media_id = :media_id AND a.access_scope = 'chat' AND a.status = 'ready'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_chat_message_media cm WHERE cm.media_id = a.media_id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_post_media pm WHERE pm.media_id = a.media_id)
post:
SELECT 1 AS permitted
FROM n_media_assets a
WHERE a.media_id = :media_id AND a.access_scope = 'post' AND a.status = 'ready'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_chat_message_media cm WHERE cm.media_id = a.media_id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM n_post_media pm WHERE pm.media_id = a.media_id AND pm.post_id <> :post_id
  )
retained:
SELECT 1 AS found
FROM n_post_media pm JOIN n_media_assets a ON a.media_id = pm.media_id
WHERE pm.post_id = :post_id
  AND SUBSTR(LOWER(REPLACE(a.storage_key, CHR(92), '/') || '/'), 1, 8) = 'private/'
  AND ROWNUM = 1
